newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones fell 59.27 points to 6,696.48. PLDT's ADR also dropped $1 to $57.50.
* The peso weakened to 26.339 to a U.S. dollar from 26.336.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,332.53, up 4.15.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was steady for the 14th day at 10.53215 percent.
